name: f2_fillprob_pseudo2025
_doc: f2 with long.fill = fill_prob (LIRF rows without AOBT_3 past 4 h: p(d) d + (1 - p(d)) median non-fill y, p logistic in log d, fitted on 2025 rows outside the held month) instead of long_stack; everything else as f2 (rules 'ad'). configs/f2_final.json on 2025. Run by research/final/pseudo_final.py on 2025 Jan/Feb/Jun/Jul with month-out members. lv_rules and recovered fit nothing on labels; daily refits its parameters without the held month on the c6 chain (c6 12-month-out OOF + level calibration with offsets excluding the held month + L0 + L0e).
